paneel.intro: Document details, texts, design basis and loads of the structural report. Everything here belongs to the project and is included in saving and undo. Grey values come from the project data or the standard.
paneel.voet: The office profile — name, logo, house style and structural engineers — is under Settings → Office. Report (PDF) in the ribbon prints the whole report; PDF sheet remains a single calculation.

velden.hoofdstukValtWeg: Empty: this chapter is not included in the report.
velden.onderdeelValtWeg: Empty or switched off: this part is not included in the report.
velden.subkopVet: Bold as a subheading in the report:
velden.subkoppenAanzetten: Turn on subheadings for this report

document.intro: What appears on the cover page. Project number, project name, client and location come from the project data.
document.titelHint: Pick a suggestion or type your own title. The project name appears below it as a subtitle.
document.geenConstructeurs: This report has no structural engineers yet. Add them under Settings → Office and update the report in the Office section at the bottom.
document.adresVoorbeeld:
Street and number
Postcode and town
document.adresHint: One address line per line; they appear on the cover page below the client's name.

revisies.intro: The first revision sets the report's first date; each later one adds a "Datum wijz." (revision date) line. The last revision sets the report status on the cover page.
revisies.leeg: No revisions yet: the cover page then leaves date and status blank.

teksten.intro: One text per part. Standard text ▾ picks a built-in or custom variant. An optional block left empty is omitted from the report.
teksten.optioneelLeeg: Leave empty to omit this part.
teksten.rolHint: The opening sentence of the section; the three details below appear underneath it as a table.
teksten.nieuwbouwKop: For new construction, use the heading "{{titel}}"
teksten.nieuwbouwAan: New construction: "Include existing situation" under Design basis is off and the "Bestaande situatie" block above is empty. Otherwise the block is called "{{titel}}".
teksten.nieuwbouwUit: Off: the block is always called "{{titel}}". A report from an earlier version opens this way, so its printout does not change.

tekstveld.bewaarTitel: Save this text in the settings so you can pick it in every report
tekstveld.bewaard: Saved as custom variant "{{label}}"; available under Standard text.
tekstveld.geenVarianten: No variants for this part yet.
tekstveld.leegmakenUitleg: An empty optional part is omitted from the report.
tekstveld.leegmakenVraag: Clear the text of this part?

invulvelden.label: Placeholder fields
invulvelden.uitleg: A placeholder field is replaced by its value in the report; an empty field becomes "—". A line starting with "-" is a bullet point; an empty line starts a new paragraph.
invulvelden.subkoppenUitleg: A short line (at most {{aantal}} words) ending in ":", such as "Foundation:", is printed in bold in the report, in all texts and in the notes on the sheets.
invulvelden.subkoppenUit: Off: such lines stay plain text. A report from an earlier version opens this way, so its printout does not change.

uitgangspunten.intro: Grey values follow from the project data and the standard; they are calculated when the report is laid out and are not saved.
uitgangspunten.soortHint: Pick from the list or type your own description.
uitgangspunten.verwijzingHint: Shown to the right of the table. A "-" means: no requirement.
uitgangspunten.factorenHint: The load factors and load combinations follow from consequence class CC{{cc}} according to tables NB.3, NB.4 and NB.5 of NEN-EN 1990. There is nothing to fill in here; the print preview shows the table.
uitgangspunten.bestaandHint: Off for new construction: the section is then omitted and the numbering moves up.
uitgangspunten.normBouwjaar: Standard from the year of construction
uitgangspunten.vervormingenHint: The introductory sentence above the table.
uitgangspunten.eisUitleg: Write a requirement as 0,004l_rep, H/300 or < 20 mm; "_rep" is printed as a subscript. An empty cell means: no requirement in that column.
uitgangspunten.vorigeNaam: This text mentions the program's previous name ({{naam}}). Standard text ▾ has the text with the current name, Open CalcSheet Studio.

belastingen.intro: Grey values follow from the project data and the standard. The build-ups in 5.5 only appear in the report; they are not (yet) used in the sheets.
belastingen.cscdHint: 1 for buildings lower than 15 m, see 6.2(1).
belastingen.prepLeeg: without a building height the column stays empty.
belastingen.onbekendeCategorie: Unknown category: pick one from the list.
belastingen.lsHint: 0,5 / 0,8 / 1,2 kN/m² for a wall weight up to 1,0 / 2,0 / 3,0 kN/m, see 6.3.1.2(8).
belastingen.qkDirect: {{qk}} kN; directly below the roof decking {{direct}} kN

opbouw.geen: No build-ups in this group yet.
opbouw.opbouwUitBibliotheekTitel: Add a complete build-up from the library as an area build-up
opbouw.laagUitBibliotheekTitel: Add a layer from the library
opbouw.wandUitBibliotheekTitel: Add a wall from the library as a layer
opbouw.verwijderVraag: Remove build-up "{{naam}}" with all its layers?

berekeningen.intro: Each sheet in the project gets a section with a summary and your own notes. The full output goes in appendix A, unless you include it in the chapter itself.
berekeningen.geenBladen: This project has no sheets yet, so the report has no Calculations chapter (a design basis document). Add sheets in the project tree; the chapter then returns and each sheet automatically gets a section here.
berekeningen.nietDoorgerekend: This sheet could not be calculated: {{fout}}
berekeningen.toelichtingVoorbeeld: Your own notes on this calculation (optional).
berekeningen.staatInHoofdstuk: The full output appears directly below the notes.
berekeningen.staatInBijlage: The full output is in appendix {{letter}}.

pdfBlad.fout: The PDF file could not be read: {{fout}}
pdfBlad.ontbreekt: The PDF file of this sheet is missing.

bijlagen.intro: Custom appendices are listed by title in the table of contents; you add the document itself outside the app.
bijlagen.vervalt: omitted: the appendix contains no output

bureau.intro: The office details and house style as stored in this report.
bureau.bijwerkenVraag: Update this report's office details from the current office profile?
bureau.geenProfiel: There is no office profile yet. Fill it in under Settings → Office and update this report here.
bureau.nietVastgelegd: This report has no stored office details yet; until then the printout uses the office profile from the settings.
bureau.profielLeeg: The office profile in the settings is empty; this report keeps its stored details.
bureau.gelijk: Same as the office profile in the settings.
bureau.wijktAf: The office profile in the settings differs from what is stored in this report. Updating only affects this report.
